subject: BrightCloud marketplace vendor onboarding — PO routing & evidence checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@brightcloud.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightCloud marketplace vendor onboarding — PO routing & evidence checklist

Hi Alice —

Great to kick off this onboarding. Attached is our standard merchant packet and a PO routing template to speed up procurement. Please confirm the billing entity and the PO contact so we can map invoices into the correct ledger. Quick asks to unblock the marketplace listing: 

- Confirm which marketplace(s) you want Redwood to list you on (AWS / Azure / GCP).
- Provide legal billing entity, address, and tax ID (W-9 or equivalent).
- Provide the name/email of the person who will sign the Redwood contract in DocuSign.
- Any reseller/partner tax IDs we should be aware of for marketplace transactions.
- If there are any required evidence items for security/compliance (SOC 2 cert, IP addendum), flag them now.

Attachments: [Redwood_merchant_onboarding_packet.pdf] [PO-routing-template.xlsx] [evidence-binder-checklist.docx]

Next steps on our side: Vanessa will validate PO routing lanes and Karthik will pick up the marketplace integration checklist once we have your confirmed marketplace preference. If you can return the W-9 and authorized signer by EOD Thursday, we can aim for the listing intake by next week.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Partner Ops — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Redwood_merchant_onboarding_packet.pdf]

From: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@brightcloud.com>

Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 12:03:50 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightCloud marketplace vendor onboarding — PO routing & evidence checklist

Thanks Ben —

Appreciate the packet. We're happy to move forward. Answers below: 

- Marketplace preference: AWS first, then Azure (we have a pending reseller agreement for GCP; can add later).
- Billing entity: BrightCloud, Inc.; Address: 121 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105
- Tax ID: 94-1234567 (W-9 attached)
- Signing authority: Melissa Grant (VP Finance), melissa.grant@brightcloud.com — she will sign in DocuSign.
- Reseller tax IDs: none for initial listing.

We attach the signed W-9 and a signed letter of authorization for Melissa. We anticipate internal PO issuance within 5–7 business days after contracts are in place. One question — does Redwood require vendor setup in your AR system prior to accepting marketplace invoices, or can we route via the marketplace billing flows directly?

Attaching: [BrightCloud_W9.pdf] [BrightCloud_signing_authorization.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@brightcloud.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:20:10 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightCloud marketplace vendor onboarding — PO routing & evidence checklist

Alice — thanks for the quick turnaround and attaching the W-9. Short answers to your routing question and a couple clarifications: 

- Routing: For AWS marketplace listings, invoices are processed through the AWS billing flow (marketplace invoices to Redwood are reconciled against AWS settlement reports). That means you DO NOT need a separate vendor record in Redwood AR for AWS-first deals, but we still need the billing contact and an invoice alias so payments map correctly.
- For Azure and GCP, commercial marketplace requirements differ; Vanessa can confirm whether we need a vendor record for Azure and GCP listings.
- DocuSign: I created the envelope and sent to Melissa (link below). Please have her sign so we can attach the contract to the intake ticket.

DocuSign: https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/BRI-2026-1137

Vanessa — could you confirm whether BrightCloud needs a Redwood vendor record for Azure listings and whether we require PO before enabling the listing? Also please validate the invoice alias process and any special tax handling.

Alice, I'll have Karthik reach out with the marketplace-integration checklist and the technical items for listing (logo, description, SKU mapping, AWS marketplace vendor ID).

Thanks,
Ben
[Quoted original email]
[Attachment: PO-routing-template.xlsx]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: BrightCloud marketplace vendor onboarding — PO routing & evidence checklist

Quick internal note — routing & evidence: 

- AWS: No vendor record required in AR for marketplace-driven invoices; we reconcile via AWS settlement. We DO need the invoice alias set to "BrightCloud-AWS" to attach settlement items correctly.
- Azure: Requires vendor record in our AR (partner must be onboarded) — procurement will issue a vendor ID (VID-77XXX). Expect a 3–5 business day vendor setup after we receive W-9 and signed contract.
- GCP: Typically reseller path; we'll add later once reseller agreement is confirmed.

I've opened Procurement ticket PRC-2026-4489 and attached Marketplace-integration-checklist.csv to the ticket. Karthik — once you have BrightCloud's AWS vendor ID (if they provide one) or marketplace vendor GUID, add to the ticket and I'll push vendor setup for Azure.

Attachments: [Marketplace-integration-checklist.csv]

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Finance Lead — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

On Tue, Aug 25, 2026 at 03:20 PM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alice — thanks for the quick turnaround…

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@brightcloud.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: marketplace integration checklist & timeline

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the details. I'm the marketplace intake lead and will own the technical checklist for listing. Summary / timeline below: 

1) Docs & signatures (today–2 days): We have your W-9 and signing authorization. Please sign the DocuSign envelope (Ben sent link).
2) Marketplace metadata (1–3 days after signatures): We need: company logo (PNG, 600x600), short description (200–400 chars), 1–3 screenshots, and SKU mapping (sample invoice line items).
3) AWS listing (3–7 business days after metadata): We will create the AWS private offer and request your AWS seller GUID. Payment flow will be via AWS marketplace settlement — set invoice alias to "BrightCloud-AWS".
4) Azure listing (5–10 business days): We require vendor vid from our Procurement team; Vanessa has opened PRC-2026-4489. Procurement will need the signed contract and W-9 to create the vendor record.
5) GCP (TBD): Set up after reseller agreement is finalized.

Action items for BrightCloud: 
- Melissa Grant to sign DocuSign (link: https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/BRI-2026-1137)
- Upload logo + screenshots to our shared Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/merchant-onboarding/BRI-2026-1137
- Confirm desired SKU names for marketplace (one-line per SKU).

If you confirm AWS-only for initial launch, we can keep the Azure setup in parallel so there is no blocker once the vendor record is ready. Let us know if you prefer us to wait on Azure.

Thanks and welcome aboard — excited to get BrightCloud live.

—Karthik
Product Partnerships — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Marketplace-integration-checklist.csv]
